Zhight Island (Quest)#000.dst: 与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 {p} 的 Zhight 对话

Zhight Island (Quest)#001.src: Hello, esteemed tourist sir or madame! I see you have found my illustrious resort, {p}!
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.dst: 您好，尊贵的游客先生或女士！看来您找到了我这间赫赫有名的度假村，{p}！
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#002.src: Normally, you'd need a reservation to stay here, but our human visitors are ALWAYS welcome! Ehm...
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.dst: 平常要住这里得先预约，不过我们永远欢迎人类访客！呃……
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#003.src: ...w-well, actually...wait, no, it's nothing, nothing, friend! I guarantee you'll enjoy your stay here!
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.dst: ……其、其实……等等，不，没什么，没什么，朋友！我保证您会在这里住得很愉快！
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#004.src: Even if m-my usual supplies haven't arrived in weeks, I, um, I'm TOTALLY sure we can accommodate for you!
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.dst: 就算我、我平常的物资已经好几个星期没送来了，我，呃，我绝对确定我们能好好招待您！
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#005.src: We can just...um...w-well, I won't impose on you, dearest most welcomest traveller, no sir! Or madame!
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.dst: 我们可以就……呃……好、好吧，我不会给您添麻烦的，最最亲爱最最受欢迎的旅人，不会的先生！或女士！
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#006.src: B-But, if, perchance, you were to, um...happen to find my supplier, Phief, who hasn't come around in weeks the bas-
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.dst: 不、不过，如果，万一，您碰巧，呃……遇到我的供货商 Phief，那个好几个星期没来的混——
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#007.src: I! I mean! Nothing, nothing! Just, ehm, our extra reliable supplier often stops by {p} for supplies...
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.dst: 我！我是说！没什么，没什么！只是，呃，我们那位超级可靠的供货商经常去 {p} 进货……
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#008.src: S-So, if you just happen to stop by there after your lovely stay here, and tell him to get off his sorry butt and send me my supplies that'd be just peachy!
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.dst: 所、所以，如果您在这里愉快地住完之后刚好去那边，叫他挪挪他那没用的屁股，把我的物资送来，那就再好不过了！
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#010.src: Hello there. I see Zhight has sent you, correct?
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.dst: 你好。是 Zhight 派你来的，对吧？
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#011.src: I do hope he isn't mad at me. I fully intended to bring the supplies to him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.dst: 希望他没生我的气。我是真的打算把物资送去给他的。
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#012.src: But things took a turn for the worst quickly, and I no longer have access to my ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.dst: 可是情况很快就变糟了，我现在没法上我的船了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#013.src: A madman jumped onto my ship, overpowered me, and held me hostage!
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.dst: 一个疯子跳上我的船，制服了我，还把我当人质！
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#014.src: He was telling me how he wanted to "take back what was stolen from him", and it looked like he was heading to {p}.
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.dst: 他一直跟我说他想“夺回被偷走的东西”，看起来他是要往 {p} 去。
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#015.src: I have no clue whether he was deranged, paranoid, or if someone really did take something from him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.dst: 我完全不知道他是疯了、妄想，还是真的有人偷了他的东西。
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#016.src: I am certain of one thing. Nobody is going to sail my boat but me. I took my first chance to escape, broke the controls.
Zhight Island (Quest)#016.dst: 有一件事我很确定。除了我，谁也别想开我的船。我一有机会就逃了，还把操控装置弄坏了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#016.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#017.src: And I swam back to land, here. Problem is, I haven't exactly decided how I'll get the ship back for myself.
Zhight Island (Quest)#017.dst: 然后我就游回陆地，到了这里。问题是，我还没想好要怎么把船拿回来。
Zhight Island (Quest)#017.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#018.src: Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here. I'd love to get my sea legs back.
Zhight Island (Quest)#018.dst: 也许你能帮我这个忙。船应该还卡在这里正北方。我真想重新站上甲板。
Zhight Island (Quest)#018.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#019.src: Find Phief's ship, and return it to its rightful owner
Zhight Island (Quest)#019.dst: 找到 Phief 的船，把它还给真正的主人

Zhight Island (Quest)#020.src: He told you what?! That fumbleknuckle...
Zhight Island (Quest)#020.dst: 他跟你说什么？！那个笨手笨脚的家伙……
Zhight Island (Quest)#020.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#021.src: We didn't steal the ship from Phief, we were taking back what he stole from us years ago!
Zhight Island (Quest)#021.dst: 我们没有从 Phief 那里偷船，我们是在拿回他几年前从我们这里偷走的东西！
Zhight Island (Quest)#021.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#022.src: He attacked us on our way home to {p}, kicked us off the boat, and sailed it to who-knows-where.
Zhight Island (Quest)#022.dst: 我们回 {p} 的路上他袭击了我们，把我们踢下船，然后把船开到谁知道哪里去了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#022.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#023.src: We didn't think we would ever get it back, until we started seeing him sailing to that doofbumble Zhight.
Zhight Island (Quest)#023.dst: 我们本来以为再也拿不回来了，直到我们开始看到他开船去找那个糊涂蛋 Zhight。
Zhight Island (Quest)#023.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#024.src: Luckily, he decided to claim an island so close to {p}, or else we would have never seen him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#024.dst: 幸好他决定占的岛离 {p} 那么近，不然我们根本不会看到他。
Zhight Island (Quest)#024.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#025.src: My father started following him with a small sailboat he made, and decided on the perfect place to attack.
Zhight Island (Quest)#025.dst: 我爸爸开着他自己做的小帆船开始跟踪他，还挑好了下手的最佳地点。
Zhight Island (Quest)#025.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#026.src: But then Phief just had to throw a hissy fit and leave us stranded here.
Zhight Island (Quest)#026.dst: 可是 Phief 偏偏大发脾气，把我们困在了这里。
Zhight Island (Quest)#026.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#027.src: My father took a paddleboat back to {p} to gather supplies. He took the cargo the ship had with him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#027.dst: 我爸爸划着脚踏船回 {p} 去找补给了。他把船上的货物也一起带走了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#027.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#028.src: If you need that, you should go talk to him. His name is Czytash.
Zhight Island (Quest)#028.dst: 如果你需要那些货，就去找他谈吧。他叫 Czytash。
Zhight Island (Quest)#028.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#029.src: Get Zhight's supplies from Czytash at {p}
Zhight Island (Quest)#029.dst: 在 {p} 向 Czytash 取回 Zhight 的物资

Zhight Island (Quest)#030.src: Ah, yes, I did find plenty o' supplies on that ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#030.dst: 啊，对，我在那艘船上确实找到了不少物资。
Zhight Island (Quest)#030.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#031.src: I assumed it was more of Phief's thiefed goods, so I took it home to use it myself.
Zhight Island (Quest)#031.dst: 我以为又是 Phief 偷来的赃物，所以就拿回家自己用了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#031.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#032.src: It is Zhight's supplies you say?
Zhight Island (Quest)#032.dst: 你说那是 Zhight 的物资？
Zhight Island (Quest)#032.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#033.src: Aye, of course it had to be that idiot's.
Zhight Island (Quest)#033.dst: 唉，当然了，肯定是那个白痴的。
Zhight Island (Quest)#033.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#034.src: I guess me thinking he's dumber'n a box o' rocks is no reason for me to let him starve... Here, take the crate.
Zhight Island (Quest)#034.dst: 我想，就算我觉得他比一箱石头还蠢，也不能因此让他饿死……给，拿走这个箱子。
Zhight Island (Quest)#034.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#035.src: I haven't opened it yet, so everything is left exactly how he ordered it.
Zhight Island (Quest)#035.dst: 我还没打开过，所以里面的东西完全跟他订的一样。
Zhight Island (Quest)#035.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#036.src: I wonder what is on that numbskull's menu, that crate smelled rancid. Almost threw it off me boat.
Zhight Island (Quest)#036.dst: 真好奇那个傻瓜的菜单上都有什么，那个箱子臭得要命。我差点把它扔下船。
Zhight Island (Quest)#036.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#037.src: Anyways, good luck on your adventure matey.
Zhight Island (Quest)#037.dst: 总之，祝你冒险顺利，伙计。
Zhight Island (Quest)#037.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#038.src: Sorry, what was that? My son?
Zhight Island (Quest)#038.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#039.src: Ah, I figured it is about time he learned how to maneuver a boat. I fixed everything before I left.
Zhight Island (Quest)#039.dst: 啊，我想他也该学学怎么驾船了。我走之前把一切都修好了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#039.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#040.src: When he returns, he will return a man.
Zhight Island (Quest)#040.dst: 等他回来的时候，他就是个男子汉了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#040.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#041.src: Wait, why am I telling you this? Butt out of my personal life, and just bring the man his crate.
Zhight Island (Quest)#041.dst: 等等，我干嘛跟你说这些？少管我的私事，把箱子送去给他就是了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#041.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#043.src: Ahaaa, esteemed sir! Or madame! I can't actually tell under all that armour...
Zhight Island (Quest)#043.dst: 啊哈——尊贵的先生！或女士！您穿着这身盔甲，我实在分辨不出来……
Zhight Island (Quest)#043.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#044.src: ER! I MEAN! N-No trouble at all, esteemed visitor! We at {p} Resort are always welcoming!
Zhight Island (Quest)#044.dst: 呃！我是说！不、不麻烦，一点都不麻烦，尊贵的访客！我们 {p} 度假村永远欢迎您！
Zhight Island (Quest)#044.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#045.src: ...wait, is that the... Oh my! The supply crate! You went out and found Phief?! What an upstanding fellow you are!
Zhight Island (Quest)#045.dst: ……等等，那是……噢天哪！物资箱！您出去找到了 Phief？！您真是个正直的好人！
Zhight Island (Quest)#045.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#046.src: Wait, he was a boat thief? Well, good thing you've told me, we can't have pirates here at our resort! I'll blacklist him ASAP!
Zhight Island (Quest)#046.dst: 等等，他是个偷船贼？好吧，还好您告诉我了，我们度假村可不能有海盗！我马上把他列入黑名单！
Zhight Island (Quest)#046.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#047.src: You're only a visitor but you've been more help today than anyone else, really, I'm honestly in your debt.
Zhight Island (Quest)#047.dst: 您只是位访客，今天却比任何人都帮了更多的忙，真的，我实在欠您一份人情。
Zhight Island (Quest)#047.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#048.src: So here! The repairs at the Zhight Grand Exchange and Zhight Treasure Tour have just finished, so you can head in and see the fruits of your labor!
Zhight Island (Quest)#048.dst: 所以，您看！Zhight 大交易所和 Zhight 寻宝之旅的修缮刚刚完工，您可以进去看看您努力的成果！
Zhight Island (Quest)#048.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#049.src: And, as a token of my thanks, some exclusive currency for our resort, Zhight Money, on the house and just for you! I hope you enjoy your stay!
Zhight Island (Quest)#049.dst: 还有，作为我的谢礼，这是我们度假村专用的货币，Zhight 币，免费送您，专属于您！祝您住得愉快！
Zhight Island (Quest)#049.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#050.src: Terribly sorry but the Zhight Grand Exchange is under repairs right now! You can't go in yet!

Zhight Island (Quest)#051.src: Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here, it has a red and white sail. I'd love to get my sea legs back.

similar.text: Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here. I'd love to get my sea legs back.
